title: Dr. Patrick Awuru Olima, born on March 17, 1951, in Benue State, Nigeria, is a distinguished medical professional known for his expertise in obstetrics and gynecology. After completing his early education, he pursued a pre-science course at Ahmadu Bello University and later studied medicine at the National University of Ireland, where he excelled. Dr. Olima has worked in various hospitals in Ireland before returning to Nigeria to establish a private medical center, driven by a desire to serve his community. He has held significant roles in both the medical field and Nigerian politics, being a member of several political parties and a key figure in Benue politics. In addition to his professional achievements, Dr. Olima is an avid sports enthusiast and enjoys athletics and soccer. He is married and has children, embodying a life dedicated to both medicine and public service.
